svg.title: A neighbor mean written as reducer algebra
svg.desc: The user defines lift, combine and finalize over a (sum, count) pair. Each value becomes (value, 1), pairs merge by componentwise addition, and finalize divides the sum by the count. Because combine is associative and commutative, any combine order gives the same result.
svg.text: A neighbor mean written as reducer algebra
concrete: node 0 gathers values 1.0 and 4.0 — the combine order does not matter
